lines.trans: Tolya, maybe we should go to headquarters?
We have been sitting in the car for two days.
Wait a bit, Sokolov. Do not hurry.
I am to blame for all our troubles.
I am a very bad officer and a bad leader.
Tolya, you are a wonderful leader and an excellent officer!
I would go into reconnaissance with you!
You are my main teacher and true mentor.
Sokolov, you have moved me very deeply right now.
Let me hug you tightly, my friend!
Tolya, just don't cry, everything is fine.
What strange music is playing in the car now.
Yes, it is a bit awkward hugging to such music.
You ruined such a wonderful and sentimental moment!

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: short forms виноват / виновата / виноваты are used for 'it's my/your fault'

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.
The children are playing in the courtyard.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: Which car did you come in?
We'll find some music right now.
I like listening to quiet music.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The teacher became my main mentor.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
in an awkward or embarrassed manner

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

обниматься.gloss: to hug each other, to embrace

meanings.en: to hug, to embrace each other
to hug, to put one's arms around

examples.text: Юля, ну иди сюда, не обижайся! Иди обниму!
examples.trans: Yulia, come here, don't be upset! Come let me hug you!
The father hugged his daughter tightly.

meanings.note: commissioned member of armed or security forces

examples.trans: He is an experienced army officer.

meanings.note: cause ruin to a family or thing

examples.trans: She is the new head of the headquarters.

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: куда ты спешишь? = where are you rushing to?

examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?
